title: Uncertainty-Driven Replay Memory for Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.29860v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Uncertainty estimation provides promising capabilities for reinforcement learning (RL) agents. Notably, estimating uncertainty can reduce the training time and enable agents to obtain greater rewards over time by exploiting information related to whether an action would facilitate exploration of portions of an environment that are well-known versus those that are relatively unknown. In this work, we propose a novel formulation of the experience replay buffer commonly used in RL that we call uncertainty-driven replay memory (UDRM), which entails an update scheme for internally stored memories based on uncertainty estimates obtained by an RL model during training. In contrast to existing forms of RL, which typically use temporal difference error or the distribution of transitions to update the replay memory buffer and train RL controllers, our scheme biases the memory buffer to store more uncertain transitions that will improve an RL agent

translated_title: 基于不确定性驱动的强化学习回放记忆
translated_abstract: 不确定性估计为强化学习（RL）智能体提供了颇具前景的能力。值得注意的是，估计不确定性可以通过利用与动作是否有助于探索环境中已被充分认知区域或相对未知区域相关的信息，来缩短训练时间，并使智能体随时间推移获得更大的奖励。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种强化学习中常用经验回放缓冲区的新颖形式，我们称之为不确定性驱动的回放记忆（UDRM），它包含一种基于强化学习模型在训练期间获得的不确定性估计来更新内部存储记忆的方案。与现有强化学习方法通常使用时间差分误差或转移分布来更新回放记忆缓冲区并训练强化学习控制器不同，我们的方案使记忆缓冲区偏向于存储更多不确定的转移，从而改进强化学习智能体。
tldr: 该论文提出了不确定性驱动的回放记忆（UDRM），利用模型的不确定性估计来更新经验回放缓冲区，使其偏向存储更不确定的转移，从而提升强化学习智能体的训练效率和性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Uncertainty-Driven Replay Memory (UDRM), a novel experience replay buffer formulation that uses uncertainty estimates to bias memory storage toward more uncertain transitions, improving RL agent performance.
